questions.question: What should you do to stop an engine fire from spreading?
questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the engine off
questions.explanation: Turn off the engine as soon as possible to help stop an engine fire from spreading.

questions.question: While driving, if you notice something that affects safety or could cause mechanical problems, you should:

options.text: Wait to see if the problem goes away.
Write it down in your report.

questions.correctAnswerText: Write it down in your report.
questions.explanation: At the end of your shift, you may need to complete a written report on your vehicle's condition. Always mention anything that could affect safety or cause mechanical problems.

questions.question: Within 10 minutes of stopping on the side of the road, you must:
questions.correctAnswerText: Place emergency warning devices.
questions.explanation: If you stop on the side of the road, you must place emergency warning devices within 10 minutes.

questions.question: Texting while driving should:

options.text: Only be done on straight roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never be done.
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is dangerous and is not allowed at any time when operating a commercial vehicle.

questions.question: If you cannot tell if the road is icy, a driver should:

options.text: Feel the side mirror for ice by opening the window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Feel the side mirror for ice by opening the window.
questions.explanation: If you think the road may be icy but are not sure, open your window and touch the front of the side mirror, mirror support, or antenna. If ice is on these items, the road is likely icy too.

questions.question: Roads are most slippery right after rain starts because:

options.text: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road that has not washed away yet.
Gravel washes into the middle of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road that has not washed away yet.
questions.explanation: When rain first begins, water mixes with oil drippings on the road, creating a very slippery surface.

questions.question: When transporting cargo, you must check that it is secured every:
questions.correctAnswerText: 150 miles
questions.explanation: Check cargo securement within the first 50 miles of a trip, then check again every three hours or 150 miles.

questions.question: Backing with a trailer is dangerous because:

options.text: You cannot see everything behind the vehicle.
Most trucks cannot go in reverse.
Cargo may fall out of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see everything behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Backing is dangerous because you cannot see everything behind you. Only back up if absolutely necessary.

questions.question: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers have good reasons for their actions

questions.correctAnswerText: Assume other drivers have good reasons for their actions
questions.explanation: Avoid aggressive driving by giving other drivers the benefit of the doubt. Assume they have valid reasons for what they do, and do not take their actions personally.

questions.question: When slowing down, you should ____ to warn other drivers
questions.correctAnswerText: Tap your brakes lightly
questions.explanation: Before slowing down, lightly tap your brakes. This makes your brake lights flash and warns drivers behind you.

questions.question: For controlled braking, you should:

options.text: Brake as hard as you can without locking the wheels.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brake as hard as you can without locking the wheels.
questions.explanation: Controlled braking means pushing the brakes hard without locking the wheels. Keep small steering movements when using this method.

questions.question: When backing into an alley, you should first:

options.text: Position your vehicle directly in front of the alley.
Back up directly in front of the alley.
Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop parallel to the outer edge of the alley.
questions.explanation: For alley docking, first pull past the alley and stop parallel to its outer edge. Then back your vehicle straight into the parking space.

questions.question: A bus driver:

options.text: Does not need to wear a seat belt.
Should wear a seat belt but is not required to.
Must always wear a seat belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must always wear a seat belt.
questions.explanation: Bus drivers must always use their seat belts.

questions.question: Before a trip, check your windshield by doing everything except:

options.text: Remove and sharpen the wiper blades.
Check the wipers have proper spring tension.
Check the wiper blades for damage.

questions.correctAnswerText: Remove and sharpen the wiper blades.
questions.explanation: Look for cracks or damage on the windshield. Check the wiper arms for proper tension and check the wiper blades for damage or worn rubber.

questions.question: A lane change should be:
questions.correctAnswerText: Done slowly.
questions.explanation: Make lane changes slowly and smoothly.

questions.question: If you must drive slowly and block traffic, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Use your emergency flashers.
questions.explanation: Turn on your four-way flashers to warn drivers behind you when driving slowly and blocking traffic flow.

questions.question: A ramp's speed limit:

options.text: Is safe for cars but may be too fast for large trucks.
Is a suggestion and can be exceeded.

questions.correctAnswerText: Is safe for cars but may be too fast for large trucks.
questions.explanation: Speed limits on ramps are set for cars. Large or heavy trucks may need to go slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: Texting while driving compared to talking on a cell phone is:
questions.correctAnswerText: More dangerous.
questions.explanation: Texting is more dangerous than talking on a phone. It distracts your mind and takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver confronts you, you should:

options.text: Keep your vehicle in front of them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ignore their gestures.
questions.explanation: Don't respond to an angry driver's actions or gestures. Do not make eye contact. Move out of their way safely.

questions.question: If your vehicle hydroplanes, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Not use the brakes.
questions.explanation: Do not brake if hydroplaning. Instead, release the accelerator and push in the clutch to slow down and regain traction.
